subject: prd/abandoned-feature-retirement
statement: Confine abandoned-feature retirement to repository-local exclusive identities and exclude archive, remote cleanup, and delivered-feature decommissioning.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: The approved appetite addresses one destructive repository lifecycle. NG-1, NG-4, and design review keep broader archival and decommission policy in separate contracts.
fit_criterion: The design and plan map every implementation task to the in-scope lifecycle and contain no historical-record deletion, remote cleanup, shared-unit retirement, or delivered-feature decommission step.
